title.narrative: The Country Programme Document (CPD) 2024-2028, effective from March 2024, restructured planning, monitoring, evaluation, and research to enhance program support. The RPM&E section achieved significant results, including training over 60 civil society organizations, refining partnership management, and improving planning methodologies. Interactive dashboards were developed, boosting operational transparency. Research and evaluations supported advocacy and policy discussions, particularly on child violence and immunization. The SEAL Initiative&39;s conclusion highlighted the importance of robust data and transparent reporting. These actions by RPM&E significantly improved overall program performance and impact.
